title: Text Snippets
shortDescription: Raycast-style text snippets with automatic inline expansion and visual WinUI 3 editor.
description: Text Snippets brings the beloved, frictionless Raycast-style snippet expansion to Microsoft PowerToys Command Palette. It supports instant inline expansion across any Windows application, interactive multiple-choice pickers, dynamic variables ({date}, {time}, {clipboard}, {uuid}), and a modern visual WinUI 3 editor with Mica backdrop. 100% offline, private, and local.
